title: Simultaneous Prediction of Functional States and Types of cis -regulatory Modules Reveals Their Prevalent Dual Uses as Enhancers and Silencers
authors: Yuan S; Ni P; Su Z
one_liner_zh: 该文用两步机器学习策略预测顺式调控元件的功能状态与类型（增强子/沉默子），虽涉及转录调控与表观遗传特征，但未聚焦TF-DNA三维互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract:
Our understanding of the precise locations of cis -regulatory elements (CRMs) in the genomes, as well as their functional types (enhancer or silencer), states (active or inactive) and target genes in various cell/tissue types of organisms remains limited, despite recent progresses. To address these challenges, we have recently developed a two-step strategy that first predicts a more complete map of CRMs in the genome, and then predicts the functional states of the CRMs. However, our initial approach lacked the ability to differentiate between the functional types of CRMs. Therefore, we utilized distinct features to simultaneously predict the functional types and states of the CRMs. Applying our method to 107 cell/tissue types with the minimum of required data available, we predicted 868,948 (73.8%) of the CRMs to be active as enhancers or silencers in at least one of these cell/tissue types. In 56 cell/tissue types with required data available for both enhancers and silencers, we predicted that 117,646 (14.8%) and 227,211 (28.6%) CRMs only functioned as enhancers (enhancer-predominant) and silencers (silencer-predominant), respectively, while 83,985 (10.6%) functioned both as enhancers and silencers (dual functional). Thus, both dual functional CRMs and silencers might be more prevalent than previously assumed. Most dual functional CRMs function either as enhancers or silencers in different cell/tissue types (Type I), while some have dual functions regulating different genes in the same cell/tissue types (Type II). Different types of CRMs display different lengths and TFBS densities, reflecting the complexity of their functions. Our two-step approach can accurately predict the functional types and states of CRMs using data of only five epigenetic marks in a cell/tissue type.

Author Summary

CRMs function as enhancers and/or silencers to promote and repress, respectively, the transcription of genes in a spatiotemporal manner, thereby playing critical roles in virtually all biological processes. However, despite recent progress, the understanding of CRMs remains limited. Most existing methods are aimed to simultaneously predict the locations and functional states of enhancers in a given cell/tissue type, however, the accuracy of these one-step methods is low. We have recently developed a two-step strategy that first predicts locations of CRMs in the genome, and then predicts their functional states as enhancers in cell/tissue types with high accuracy. However, our initial approach was unable to differentiate between enhancers and silencers. Therefore, in this study, we employ two machine-learning models, so that we can simultaneously predict the functional states and types of our previously predicted 1.2M CRMs in various cell/tissue types. Applying the method to cell/tissue types with the data available, we categorize the CRMs into four types with distinct properties reflecting their functional complexity. Our results indicate that silencers and dual functional CRMs might be more prevalent than previously assumed. The precise prediction of CRM types and states provides opportunities to pinpoint their target genes, thus opening new avenues for research.
abstract_zh:
尽管近期取得了进展，但我们对基因组中顺式调控元件（CRMs）的精确定位，以及它们在各种细胞/组织类型中的功能类型（增强子或沉默子）、状态（活跃或非活跃）和靶基因的理解仍然有限。为应对这些挑战，我们近期开发了一种两步策略，首先预测基因组中更完整的CRM图谱，然后预测CRM的功能状态。然而，我们最初的方法缺乏区分CRM功能类型的能力。因此，我们利用不同的特征来同时预测CRM的功能类型和状态。将我们的方法应用于107种具有所需最少数据的细胞/组织类型，我们预测868,948个（73.8%）CRM在至少一种这些细胞/组织类型中作为增强子或沉默子处于活跃状态。在56种同时具有增强子和沉默子所需数据的细胞/组织类型中，我们预测117,646个（14.8%）和227,211个（28.6%）CRM分别仅作为增强子（增强子主导）和沉默子（沉默子主导）发挥作用，而83,985个（10.6%）同时作为增强子和沉默子发挥作用（双重功能）。因此，双重功能CRM和沉默子可能比以前认为的更为普遍。大多数双重功能CRM在不同细胞/组织类型中要么作为增强子要么作为沉默子发挥作用（I型），而有些则在相同细胞/组织类型中具有调节不同基因的双重功能（II型）。不同类型的CRM表现出不同的长度和转录因子结合位点（TFBS）密度，反映了其功能的复杂性。我们的两步方法仅使用细胞/组织类型中五种表观遗传标记的数据，即可准确预测CRM的功能类型和状态。

作者总结

CRM作为增强子和/或沉默子，分别以时空方式促进和抑制基因的转录，从而在几乎所有生物过程中发挥关键作用。然而，尽管近期有进展，对CRM的理解仍然有限。大多数现有方法旨在同时预测给定细胞/组织类型中增强子的位置和功能状态，但这些一步方法的准确性较低。我们近期开发了一种两步策略，首先预测基因组中CRM的位置，然后以高准确性预测它们在细胞/组织类型中作为增强子的功能状态。然而，我们最初的方法无法区分增强子和沉默子。因此，在本研究中，我们采用两种机器学习模型，以便能够同时预测我们先前预测的1.2M CRM在各种细胞/组织类型中的功能状态和类型。将方法应用于具有可用数据的细胞/组织类型，我们将CRM分为四种具有不同特性的类型，反映其功能复杂性。我们的结果表明，沉默子和双重功能CRM可能比以前认为的更为普遍。对CRM类型和状态的精确预测为确定其靶基因提供了机会，从而开辟了新的研究途径。
